The **Patient Perspective** within the context of the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] highlights the immediate informational and support needs of individuals newly diagnosed with atrial fibrillation. According to the registry's reporting, patients express a strong desire for structured educational programs to be offered shortly after their diagnosis is confirmed [^src1]. This underscores a critical priority in post-diagnostic care, emphasizing that timely, organized patient education is highly valued by those navigating a new chronic heart condition. Because the available evidence for this specific theme is limited to this single assertion in the provided corpus, this summary reflects exactly what the data documents without further speculation or padding.

## Claims
- Patienterne ser et stort behov for et tilbud om et struktureret undervisningsforløb kort tid efter, diagnosen er stillet [^src1] (databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark)
